plastic_snow.title: PLASTIC SNOW
paragraphs: THE LASER FIRES FOR NINETY-ONE SECONDS. THE SKY OUTSIDE THE VIEWPORT CLEARS LIKE A WINDOW WIPED WITH A RAG. TELEMETRY CALLS IT A 100% CLEARANCE EVENT. THE DASHBOARD TURNS A PLEASANT GREEN.

BY MORNING THE PARTICULATE PLUME HAS ENTERED THE UPPER ATMOSPHERE. IT DOES NOT COME DOWN AS ASH. IT COMES DOWN AS SOMETHING SOFTER AND MORE EVEN, DRIFTING THROUGH STREETLIGHTS AND OVER ROOFS AND INTO OPEN MOUTHS.
THE WIRE SAYS PEOPLE WENT OUTSIDE TO WATCH IT FALL. SOME OF THEM CALLED IT BEAUTIFUL. THE WORD 'SNOW' IS USED IN EVERY OFFICIAL BULLETIN. NOBODY OFFICIAL USES THE WORD 'DUST'.
THE STATION RECEIVES ONE FINAL INSTRUCTION FROM THE SURFACE: KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK. THE QUOTA FOR NEXT QUARTER HAS BEEN INCREASED.
plastic_snow.epilogue: YOU MADE THE PROBLEM INVISIBLE. THE MATTER STAYED. IT ALWAYS STAYS.
plastic_snow.stat_line: ORBIT CLEARED - ATMOSPHERE CONTAMINATED - QUOTA RAISED

endless_loop.title: THE ENDLESS LOOP
paragraphs: YOU KEEP FLYING. SHIFT AFTER SHIFT. THE HOLD FILLS, THE HOLD EMPTIES, THE QUOTA TICKS UP, THE QUOTA IS RAISED. THE STATION'S LIGHTS COME BACK ON AND STAY ON. THIS IS, BY EVERY METRIC THE STATION KNOWS HOW TO PRINT, A SUCCESS.

THE DEBRIS FIELD DOES NOT SHRINK. IT IS NOT A PILE; IT IS A PROCESS. EVERY COLLECTION RUN PLAYS A SMALL PART IN A SYSTEM THAT WILL PRODUCE TOMORROW'S DEBRIS FROM TODAY'S DEVICES, AT THE SAME RATE, FOREVER.
THE MACHINE THAT MAKES THE JUNK AND THE MACHINE THAT CLEANS IT ARE BOTH RUNNING PERFECTLY. THE FIRST ONE IS PAID FOR. THE SECOND ONE IS YOU.
THE ARCHIVE KEEPS RECORDING. ONE DAY SOMEONE WILL OPEN IT AND FIND THE WHOLE ACCOUNTING OF AN ENTERPRISE THAT WAS ADMIRABLE IN EVERY WAY EXCEPT FOR HAVING NO END.
endless_loop.epilogue: YOU KEPT THE SYSTEM ALIVE. THE SYSTEM KEPT MAKING THE PROBLEM.
endless_loop.stat_line: QUOTA MET - QUOTA RAISED - QUOTA MET - QUOTA RAISED

last_specimen.title: THE LAST SPECIMEN
paragraphs: YOU REFUSE THE FIRING SOLUTION. THE PROTOCOL LOGS THE REFUSAL AS AN OPERATOR ANOMALY AND CONTINUES TO DISPLAY THE BUTTON, BRIGHT AND EAGER, FOR SEVEN MORE HOURS BEFORE GOING QUIET.

THE POD GOES INTO THE STATION'S ONLY PRESSURISED HOLD. INSIDE IT: SOIL, WATER, AND ELEVEN LIVING THINGS TOO SMALL TO HAVE NAMES IN ANY LANGUAGE THE COMPANY USED. THE STATION'S LIFE SUPPORT LABELS THEM 'NON-PRIORITY BIOMASS'. YOU MOVE THE LABEL SOMEWHERE NOBODY READS.

OVER ELEVEN MONTHS YOU SPEND THE SALVAGE BUDGET ON RETRIEVAL INSTEAD OF ERASURE: SORTING, REFURBISHING, RE-ENTRY BALLISTICS, A LIFE-CYCLE PROTOCOL THAT ANY GROUND FACTORY CAN FOLLOW WITHOUT A MIRACLE. IT IS SLOW. IT IS EXPENSIVE. IT DOES NOT LOOK LIKE A WINNING QUARTER.
THE TRANSMISSION TAKES FOUR DAYS TO REACH THE SURFACE. THE REPLY TAKES NINE AND SAYS ONLY: 'RECEIVED. SELECTED PORTS ARE TESTING THE PROTOCOL. SEND MORE SOIL.'
THE SPECIMEN DOES NOT SAVE THE WORLD. IT IS ELEVEN THINGS IN A JAR. BUT IT IS THE FIRST CARGO IN FORTY YEARS THAT ARRIVED SOMEWHERE WITHOUT BECOMING SOMEONE ELSE'S PROBLEM.
last_specimen.epilogue: RECOVERY OVER ERASURE. THE LIGHT COMES BACK SLOWER, BUT IT IS THE RIGHT LIGHT.
last_specimen.stat_line: PROTOCOL REFUSED - SPECIMEN SECURED - LIFECYCLE TRANSMITTED
